descriptions.value: Buffer overflow in ANGLE in Google Chrome on on Android prior to 155.0.8059.79 allowed a remote attacker to potentially execute arbitrary code outside the sandbox via a crafted HTML page. (Chromium security severity: Critical)
Insertion of sensitive information into sent data in Microsoft Teams for Android allows an authorized attacker to disclose information over a network.
